A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
methoprene at a rate of 1.0 ppm is a very effective grain protectant against R. dominica for 24 months.
methoprene can provide residual protection against R. dominica in hard red winter wheat for 24 months when used alone at rates of 2.5 or 1.25 ppm.

The main takeaway from our work is that
methoprene is a good residual grain protectant for stored wheat, rough rice, brown and corn, and can be used to protect grain in a grain bin for at least 24 months.
methoprene is an effective grain protectant against stored product insects for at least two years, and that it is a good choice for grain protectants in areas where insect resistance is of concern.
methoprene is a very effective residual insecticide that can be used in grain storage to protect grain from insect infestation.
